summary: Test only: fractal-api-core's SQL message page tests and the selector claim-edit test publish pending message selectors before they page at the store's own index. A commit folds selectors for at most 10 ms of wall time, so on a loaded host a fixture message, an edit's supersession or a deletion's promotion could still be pending, and a page was cut below the snapshot it was asked for or still showed a promoted row as superseded.

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.
